title: $L^2$-cohomology and deformations of the left regular representation
summary: We study deformations of unitary representations $π\colon G\to U(H)$ whose coefficients lie in the Hilbert-Schmidt ideal $HS(H)\subset B(H)$. Interesting applications arise for the left-regular representation of surface groups and, more generally, cocompact lattices in the automorphism group of a Fuchsian building of conformal dimension $<2$.
